Motion Jahr, Atchinson second to grant the applicant PDC AK LPIC, LLC c/o Panattoni
Development Company preliminary site plan approval with conditions to construct 3 data
processing and computer center buildings, 1 administrative office building and 1 network
service building, at the site comprised of numerous parcels with a combined area of 282.2 acres
located east of Haggerty Road, north of the N. I-94 Service Drive, west of Hannan Road and
south of Wayne County Community College and I-275, based on the analysis and subject to the
conditions detailed in the McKenna letter dated 2-1-26, Fishbeck letter dated 2-3-26, Van Buren
Fire Marshal report dated 2-2-26 and based on the statements and slides presented by the
applicant, noting also the Planning Commission approves the parking deviation, the screening
modification along the N. 1-94 Service Drive retaining the existing trees and the 8-foot high
security fence as described in the Mckenna letter, noting also the Planning Commission does
not approve payment in lieu of sidewalk construction with the understanding that further
planning assessment must be done with regard to easements of Wayne County and with the
additional conditions that the Township Board shall authorize a development agreement prior
to final site plan approval which incorporates details of the connection to the GLWA water
main and meter installation, incorporates details regarding the limitation of discharge to the
Townships sewer system of 0.75 million gallons a day, metering that discharge and the
continuation of operations of regular service, the plan incorporates recurring monitoring of
sound after completion of construction at the site and incorporates details regarding
construction road access and phasing the project to limit the impact of dust and construction
upon the adjacent properties.
